Removes regulatory risk; integration and synergies can now impact results.
Adds CCI’s revenue/EBIT to Orkla from this date, affecting Q3/Q4 comps.
Signals focus on vegan confectionery; potential category share gains.

This is a late-stage confirmation of a previously announced deal, shifting from approval risk to execution risk. For a larger catalyst, Orkla must quantify CCI’s revenue/EBIT impact and outline synergy targets and integration milestones.
